title: Cisalpine Republic
capsule: The Cisalpine Republic (Repubblica Cisalpina) was a French sister republic created by Napoleon Bonaparte on 29 June 1797 through the merger of the Cispadane and Transpadane Republics, with Milan as its capital. Its first constitution mirrored the French Constitution of 1795, with a five-member executive Directory and a bicameral legislature, but France retained effective control, requiring the republic to fund 25,000 French troops and field 35,000 of its own. Austrian and Russian forces overran it following the Battle of Cassano in April 1799, but Napoleon restored it after Marengo in June 1800; it was reorganized as the Italian Republic in January 1802, recognized at the Treaty of Lunéville.
